patterns: Direct Article-content items dominate: Art 23 traffic/forced labour, Art 24 child labour, Art 21A education as both human and fundamental right.
PHRA 1993 fact recall: in force 28 Sept 1993, armed forces definition excludes State armed forces, members are 'public servants', Special Public Prosecutor needs 7 years' practice.
Rights covered by PHRA (life, liberty, equality, dignity) are asked as 'which is not covered' traps.
Act-year items (Bonded Labour Abolition 1976, MISA not a social act) appear as fillers.
App uses many A/R and 'how many' formats; PYQs are mostly plain one-liners and simple matches.
